excerpt.zh: 我们限量向私人实体出售布洛葛腺体。适用于各类半透膜！
excerpt.en: We have a very limited quantity of Blorg glandular extract available for purchase by private entities. Great for semi-permeable membranes of all kinds!

texts.zh: 我们限量向私人实体出售布洛葛腺体。适用于各类半透膜！
texts.en: We have a very limited quantity of Blorg glandular extract available for purchase by private entities. Great for semi-permeable membranes of all kinds!

texts.zh:
人生在世总有悲伤失意之时。但是我立马就会想起，财富和幸福就在转角处等候！

告诉你的朋友们吧！
texts.en:
Sometimes it all seems so hopeless. But then I remember that wealth and happiness are just around the corner!

Tell your friends!

texts.zh:
巴尼斯营养液不是用人做的。

配方保密，但绝对健康。
texts.en:
Baneth Nutritional Slurry is NOT people.

The ingredients are secret, and very healthy.

texts.zh: 请注意，可能包含范格利废料标签的意思是说，生产该产品的设施也用作处理范格利废料，不是说这东西是范格利废料。
texts.en: Please note that the MAY CONTAIN TRACES OF VENGRALIAN WASTE stickers only indicate that the product is produced in facilities that also handle Vengralian waste, not that the product itself is Vengralian waste.

texts.zh: 我们始终欢迎下游经销商加盟。有兴趣加入范格利集团吗？
texts.en: We're always on the lookout for more downline distributors. Care to join the Trium family?

texts.zh: 你完全可以信任范格利的品质。
texts.en: You can trust the Vengralian Seal of Quality.

texts.zh: 申请退款说明买家不够信任产品。但我们充分确信麾下产品的质量。
texts.en: Offering refunds betrays a lack of confidence in your products. We have full confidence in our products.

texts.zh: 我们教外星物种坐地生财之道。
texts.en: We teach xenos how to earn a substantial additional income working from home.

texts.zh: 跟产品本身无关，关键是产品能带来多少利益。
texts.en: It's not about the products, it's about the benefits of purchasing the products.

texts.zh: 你知不知道有什么智慧生物需要一些额外的能量币收入啊？
texts.en: Do you happen to know any intelligent sapients that could use an additional stream of energy credits?

texts.zh: 虽然我们的产品根本不愁销路，但我们依然愿意花时间把它卖给您。
texts.en: While our products practically sell themselves, we will also take the time to sell them. To you.

texts.zh: 拜托了，买点什么吧。随便买点什么都行。
texts.en: Please buy something. Anything. Just... Please.

texts.zh: 范格利集团中没有老板，人人都是自己的老板。虽然这确实会带来一些……管理上的麻烦。
texts.en: Every member of the Vengralian Trium is their own boss. This does lead to some... administrative issues.

texts.zh:
范格利集团的目标就是让这世界上没有难做的生意。这是范格利的立命之本。不想做生意的想法都是……

错的。

所以……
texts.en:
The Vengralian Trium was created for commerce. It is in the Vengralian blood-analogue. Not engaging in commerce is...

Wrong.

So...

texts.zh: 就算是最古老的范格利历史收据也提到了奥伦星商人。他们提升了我们，让我们的文明从孩提时代跃进到购买他们的厨房用品。
texts.en: Even the oldest Vengralian history-receipts tell of the Orlan Star Merchants. They elevated us from beasthood to sell us kitchen appliances.

texts.zh: 范格利集团的传说就是奥伦星商人的传说。他们虽然已经不在了，但是早已规定的规定的销售指标必须达成！
texts.en: The legacy of the Vengralian Trium is also the legacy of the Orlan Star Merchants. They are no longer with us, but the prescribed quotas must still be met!

label.zh: 先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。

texts.zh:
我们将给你[Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

而我们只收取很少很少的[Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]
texts.en:
We offer you [Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

All this for the low, low price of [Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]

responses.zh: 很高兴和你做生意。记住了：有梦想就一定要实现它！
responses.en: Pleasure doing business with you. And remember: don't dream it, be it!

label.zh: 现在不行，你能过后再来吗？
label.en: Not right now. Can you get back to us later?

responses.zh: 当然了。在我们离开你们的领地之前肯定会再联系你们的。但是等到那时候，交易的内容可能就不一样了……
responses.en: But of course! We will contact you again before we depart your territories. But be aware that the deal may change in that time...
